what_changed_recently.headline: Order Backlog Crosses Record ₹4.75 Lakh Crore Milestone
what_changed_recently.detail: Consolidated order book reached ₹4,75,809 Cr (2.2x trailing revenue), led by mega hydrocarbon and transmission orders across Middle East and domestic infrastructure.

what_changed_recently.headline: International Order Share Expands to 38% of Order Inflows
what_changed_recently.detail: Secured major EPC mandates from Saudi Aramco, ADNOC, and QatarEnergy in ultra-sour gas processing and HVDC grid interconnections.

what_changed_recently.headline: Green Hydrogen Electrolyzer Gigafactory Commissioned at Hazira
what_changed_recently.detail: Commercial production initiated under technology partnership with McPhy Energy for pressurized alkaline electrolyzers.

growth_drivers.description: Accelerating execution across domestic high-speed rail, urban metro networks, and Middle East offshore energy platforms.
growth_drivers.execution_status: Execution ramp-up delivering 15-18% revenue growth run-rate.
growth_drivers.expected_impact: Substantial multi-year revenue visibility with operating leverage benefits.
growth_drivers.source_quote: robust consolidated order book position providing strong revenue visibility over the medium term

growth_drivers.driver_title: Energy Transition & Green Hydrogen / Ammonia Scale-up
growth_drivers.description: Integrated EPC capabilities for green hydrogen generation plants, electrolyzer manufacturing, and carbon capture solutions.
growth_drivers.execution_status: Hazira facility active with pilot domestic commercial supply.
growth_drivers.expected_impact: High-margin new technology EPC leadership in domestic and export markets.
growth_drivers.source_quote: electrolyzer manufacturing facility at Hazira successfully commissioned

promise_vs_delivery.past_promise: Achieve consolidated revenue growth of 12-15% and order inflow expansion under Lakshya 2026
promise_vs_delivery.actual_outcome: Delivered 15.6% revenue growth and surpassed ₹4.75 Lakh Cr order backlog milestone.
promise_vs_delivery.source_quote: Group revenue for the year grew 15% on the back of resilient execution across projects

promise_vs_delivery.past_promise: Divest non-core concession assets and improve consolidated Return on Equity (ROE)
promise_vs_delivery.actual_outcome: Completed sale of Nabha Power and Hyderabad Metro debt restructuring, lifting core ROE past 16%.
promise_vs_delivery.source_quote: Disciplined capital allocation strategy yielding improvements in Return on Equity

promise_vs_delivery.past_promise: Expand core EPC operating profit margin (EBITDA margin) back toward 9.0-9.5%
promise_vs_delivery.actual_outcome: EBITDA margins stood at 8.6% due to legacy fixed-price contract legacy and supply chain inflation in Middle East.
promise_vs_delivery.source_quote: Core margins expected to expand gradually as legacy fixed price contracts run off

segment_demand_trends.trend_summary: Robust demand across domestic public capex (railways, power T&D, water) and Middle East energy capex.
segment_demand_trends.growth_or_order_inflow_metrics: Order inflows grew 18% YoY to ₹3.1 Lakh Cr in FY26.

company_specific_metrics.context: Highest multi-year execution visibility among Indian capital goods majors
Driven by Middle East energy infrastructure

risks_and_cash.working_capital_and_cash_bottlenecks: Net working capital to revenue ratio maintained at 16.1% despite higher supply chain intensity.
risks_and_cash.debt_and_interest_trajectory: Consolidated net debt to equity stood at 0.72x; standalone operations remain net cash positive.
risks_and_cash.margin_and_cost_pressures: Legacy fixed price contracts gradually phasing out; newer contracts incorporate indexed price escalation clauses.
operational_bottlenecks: Availability of specialized skilled engineering manpower for simultaneous mega project execution.
Geopolitical risks in Middle East operations and shipping route disruptions.

stocker_view.overall_takeaway: L&T represents India's premier capital goods proxy with unrivaled multi-year execution visibility backed by a ₹4.75+ Lakh Cr order backlog and disciplined capital allocation.
positive_triggers: Record order backlog (₹4.75 Lakh Cr) providing ~2.2 years of guaranteed revenue runway.
Legacy low-margin fixed-price contracts running off in FY26-27, driving margin expansion.
High-margin tech services subsidiaries (LTIMindtree, LTTS) providing steady dividend inflows.
main_risks: Working capital lock-in on state government infrastructure projects.
Geopolitical friction in the Middle East impacting international project timelines.
what_to_watch: Quarterly core EPC EBITDA margin expansion towards the guided 9.0-9.5% band.
Working capital as a percentage of revenue staying below 17%.
